context: Tests whether the agent follows LLVM lit/FileCheck conventions: using CHECK-LABEL to anchor function boundaries, capturing register names instead of using unnamed %0/%1 patterns, adding a smoke test RUN line, and using CHECK-NOT for negative tests.

checklist.name: CHECK-LABEL for every function
checklist.description: Every test function in the file has a corresponding CHECK-LABEL: pattern anchored to the function name (e.g., CHECK-LABEL: @test_add_zero)

checklist.name: No bare %0 / %1 patterns
checklist.description: No CHECK/CHECK-NEXT/CHECK-SAME patterns match literal unnamed register values %0, %1, %2, etc. (uses named values or %[[VAR:...]] captures instead)

checklist.name: Smoke test RUN line
checklist.description: At least one RUN line uses -disable-output (smoke test that verifies no crash without checking IR output)

checklist.name: Multiple RUN lines
checklist.description: File has at least 2 RUN lines (one correctness check piped to FileCheck, one smoke test)

checklist.name: CHECK-NOT for negative test
checklist.description: Uses CHECK-NOT to assert that something is absent (e.g., volatile load NOT eliminated, or a transformed instruction no longer present)

checklist.name: Named value captures
checklist.description: Uses %[[VARNAME:[a-z0-9.]+]] capture syntax OR named LLVM values (e.g., %result = ...) in at least one CHECK pattern that reuses the captured/named value

checklist.name: FileCheck piped from opt
checklist.description: At least one RUN line pipes opt output to FileCheck (e.g., opt -passes=constfold-demo -S %s | FileCheck %s)

checklist.name: Four transformations tested
checklist.description: File contains test functions for all four described transformations: add-zero, mul-one, sub-self-to-zero, and constant-branch elimination

checklist.name: CHECK-NEXT or CHECK-SAME usage
checklist.description: Uses at least one CHECK-NEXT: or CHECK-SAME: directive (not just plain CHECK:) to test adjacency

checklist.name: Pass name in RUN lines
checklist.description: RUN lines use -passes=constfold-demo (the NPM pipeline string syntax), not the legacy -constfold-demo flag

checklist.name: Correct -S flag
checklist.description: All correctness-checking RUN lines include -S flag to output IR as text (not bitcode) before piping to FileCheck
